mapper.select: SELECT * FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY update_time DESC
SELECT * FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND goods_id = #{goodsId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart (user_id, goods_id, sku_id, goods_name, goods_image, price, quantity, checked, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{goodsId}, #{skuId}, #{goodsName}, #{goodsImage}, #{price}, #{quantity}, #{checked}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE cart SET quantity = #{quantity}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE cart SET checked = #{checked}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE cart SET checked = #{checked}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
